race.description: Bet365 Kyneton Cup Wed Nov 4 (Bm62) Hcp
race.comment: AUBAINE (11) demolished his rivals when winning his maiden at his penultimate start on the Ballarat synthetic and then overdid it outside the leader over 1600m at Moe, weakening late to finish sixth as the favourite. He drops 1.5kg and will also appreciate racing over a slightly shorter trip, so stick with him, and follow your money. BRROOSHA (10) was ridden more positively at Warrnambool and turned some modest efforts around with an easy all the way win at Warrnambool nearly 3 weeks ago, and if the track is wet, she can repeat the dose. OUR PIERRO (9) resumes from a spell after showing plenty of talent last season as a 3YO. She has had 3 jump-outs this prep to get ready, and she can take this out. RUSSIAN FRONT (6) was a last start winner who can measure up again. SEEYOU RAIDER (6) led all the way to score at Kilmore last week. Stick with him.
